seo.title: GS Agentic Manager · Greatstone International
seo.description: A digital office for your organisation: people and AI agents in clear roles on your own instance, set up by Greatstone where it fits, with your people approving what matters.

pages.html:
GS Agentic Manager

A digital office for the work that comes round every week

An AI agent team, set up for one area of your work, in your own hosted instance. Your people direct it. Every task is on record, and it stops for a person where you decide.

Ask about GS Agentic ManagerCheck your AI readiness

Built for organisations where skilled people do too much repeatable work.

  1. 01

    You have 11 to 250 people and the same reports, drafts, research and follow-ups come round every week.

  2. 02

    Your team already tries AI tools, but the results depend on who used them and nobody can see what was done.

  3. 03

    You want the hours back without hiring, and without handing control to a black box.

What every digital office starts with

Your own instance

A separate, hosted office for your organisation only. Your work and data are not shared with other clients.

An agent team set up for your work

We start with one area of work, such as operations, research or content, and give each agent a role, instructions and a manager.

Connections you agree

We connect the systems you agree once a technical check confirms each one. Access is held per agent and can be revoked at any time.

Approval points you choose

Agents work within budgets and stop for a person wherever you decide they should.

A record of every task

You can see what each agent did and why, task by task.

Hosting and maintenance

We host your instance, maintain the platform and keep backups. The terms of this service are written into your agreement.

One setup, one recurring service, one optional review.

Tailored setup

A one-off engagement, charged separately: agents and their instructions, connections to the systems you agree, an introduction for your team, training and your acceptance.

Recurring service

Hosting of your own instance and platform maintenance, including backups. Your people direct the agents and run the daily work.

Quality review (optional)

A fixed number of hours on a set cadence to improve agent instructions, tools, workflows and model choice. It improves your digital office. It does not run your business.

  1. 01

    Executive Discovery

    Free. Is there something worth exploring?

  2. 02

    Initial assessment

    Free. Where technology and AI could help, with an indicative scope.

  3. 03

    Agreement

    A written scope and a deposit before any paid work.

  4. 04

    Deep Dive and blueprint

    We map how the work is done and give you an actionable blueprint.

  5. 05

    Digital office

    Only where it fits: tailored setup, then a recurring service.

Boundaries

Agents do not move money, sign anything, give regulated advice or make decisions about people. They do not replace your team; they take repeatable work off it. AI use stays within a budget you approve, and work beyond it stops for a person. We do not build bespoke software inside this service. If the work needs any of these, we say so in the Deep Dive and scope it separately.

Not sure where to start?

Two free tools. One shows how ready you are. The other shows what the manual work costs.

AI readiness check

Find out where AI can help your business first, and what has to be in place before it does.

AI readiness check

AI cost calculator

See what your manual work costs you today. This is an estimate of your own time and spend, not a price for our services.

AI cost calculator
Common questions

The questions buyers ask first.

Your organisation has its own separate instance, which no other client shares. Which AI providers handle your work, and on whose accounts, is agreed with you before setup. Data processing terms are part of your agreement.

You are. A named person in your organisation decides where agents stop for approval, and can override or pause them. Agents work within budgets, and you can see every task they did.

The digital office works with models from more than one provider. Which models your agents use is agreed with you, based on the work, your data and your budget. When a better model arrives, an agent can move to it without rebuilding the team.

Repeatable knowledge work: first drafts, research, reports, content, summaries, follow-ups and routine checks. We start with one area of work and the work that comes round every week.

Setup is a one-off fee, agreed in writing. A recurring fee covers hosting of your own instance and platform maintenance, and the optional quality review is priced separately. AI use follows a route and a budget you agree with us. You see every figure in writing before you commit.

Both, deliberately. The consultancy comes first: we only propose a digital office where the blueprint shows it fits. We set it up on software we maintain, and your people run it. You do not buy a licence and work it out alone.

pages.title: How We Work

seo.title: How We Work · Eight Pillars · Greatstone International
seo.description: Executive Discovery, an initial assessment, a Deep Dive and an actionable blueprint, then a digital office only where it fits. The Deep Dive reads your organisation across eight pillars before anything is built.

pages.html:
How we work

We leave no stone unturned.

Every engagement follows the same path, and you decide at each step whether to go on. The Deep Dive reads your organisation across eight pillars, so the work that follows is the work that actually moves you.

Open the interactive breakdownBegin the Conversation
  1. 01

    Executive Discovery

    Free. We meet your leadership team to understand the organisation, its ambitions and the challenges that matter most. You leave knowing whether there is something worth exploring.

  2. 02

    Initial assessment

    Free. We show where technology and AI could strengthen the organisation, with demonstrations where they help, an indicative scope and a commercial perspective. Agreeing in principle carries no commitment.

  3. 03

    Agreement

    If you want to go further, we agree the scope of the Deep Dive in writing and you pay a deposit before any paid work starts.

  4. 04

    Deep Dive

    Paid, with a scope fixed before it starts. We read your organisation across the eight pillars with the people who do the work, and map where time and value are lost.

  5. 05

    Actionable blueprint

    A blueprint of what to change, in what order and why. It is yours to use, with or without us.

  6. 06

    Digital office, where it fits

    Only where the blueprint shows it fits, we set up a digital office for your organisation. Setup is charged separately, and your people run the daily work.

The Approach

One method. Eight pillars. No guesswork.

Most transformation starts with a tool and hunts for a problem. We start the other way round: an honest read of the organisation across eight pillars, so the automation that follows is pointed at the right work.

01

We score, not guess

Every pillar gets a number: a clear, defensible read of where you stand today.

02

We find the repeatable work

Inside each pillar, we look for the work that comes round every week and could run itself.

03

We climb the lowest first

The biggest gain is usually hiding in your weakest pillar. That is where we start.

The Eight Pillars

Every facet, examined.

Here’s what we look at, and what we measure, across every pillar of the method.

P·01
People
Know who moves what.

We map the relationship networks inside your company: roles, capabilities, resourcing and sentiment, so change lands with the grain, not against it.

  • Roles & reporting
  • Capabilities
  • Resourcing
  • Sentiment
P·02
Communication
Make the value land.

We evaluate how well you communicate your value, inside and out, then build strategies that leave any audience engaged.

  • Internal messaging
  • External messaging
  • Engagement
P·03
Innovation
Innovate on purpose.

We examine how deliberately you innovate, whether you do it constantly and whether your environment enables it, then benchmark you.

  • Repeatability
  • Learning loops
  • Environment
P·04
Data
Map the lifecycle.

We map your data lifecycle end to end: its structure, accessibility, accuracy, consistency, reliability and validity.

  • Structure
  • Accuracy
  • Reliability
  • Validity
P·05
Customer
Know who you serve.

We identify who your customers really are and how to serve them better, through customer intelligence, journeys and every touchpoint between.

  • Intelligence
  • Journeys
  • Touchpoints
P·06
Competition
Set the pace.

One question, answered plainly: are you staying ahead of your competitors, and how do we position you as a pioneer in your field?

  • Position
  • Market lead
  • Pioneer status
P·07
Technology
Pressure-test the stack.

We analyse your stack: how maturely you use your tools, where integrations fall short, and how resilient the infrastructure underneath really is.

  • Tool maturity
  • Integration gaps
  • Resilience
P·08
Value
Align value both ways.

We align your values with value for the customer, so every transformation pays off for you and, ultimately, for them.

  • KPIs
  • Reporting
  • Capacity
  • Performance
Pebble · Plateau · Peak

We meet you where you are.

Your eight scores place you on the mountain. We start the climb from there: no vanity scores, no theatre.

seo.title: About Greatstone · Greatstone International
seo.description: Greatstone exists to help organisations become stronger. Our purpose, our philosophy, the character of the institution and the people who do the work.

pages.html:
Greatstone exists for one reason.To help organisations become stronger.

Everything we do, and everything we decline to do, is measured against that single purpose.

What We Believe

Strong organisations are built deliberately. They are built by leaders who understand what matters before deciding what must change, and who are willing to look honestly at how their organisation actually works rather than how it is described. That belief shapes how Greatstone engages. We begin with understanding rather than assumption, we let evidence rather than instinct guide what follows, and we measure success by the strength an organisation retains long after our involvement ends.

This is not a methodology we apply to organisations. It is the standard we hold ourselves to.

The Character of the Institution

Organisations choose their partners carefully, and rightly so. These are the characteristics that shape how Greatstone works, and the ones our clients hold us to.

We look where others stop looking

The answer is usually in the part everyone had agreed to overlook. Examining it is uncomfortable and it is where the value is, so we go there first.

We build capability, not dependency

The measure of an engagement is what the organisation can do once it concludes. We are not a supplier to be managed. We are a foundation to be built upon.

We say things plainly

If a recommendation cannot be explained to the people who will live with it, the thinking behind it is not finished. Clarity is a discipline, not a style.

The Greatstone Principles

01

Understanding Before Action

Every meaningful initiative begins with understanding. Before recommending change, Greatstone develops a clear understanding of the organisation, its objectives and the factors that will determine long-term success. Only then can meaningful progress begin.

02

Evidence Before Transformation

Transformation should always be guided by evidence rather than assumption. Every recommendation should be informed by organisational understanding, sound judgement and objective insight, creating the confidence required for meaningful and sustainable transformation.

03

Execution with Purpose

Every initiative should contribute to a clearly defined organisational objective. Transformation, specialist expertise and technology should never become objectives in themselves. They should always strengthen the organisation they exist to serve.

04

Capability That Endures

The measure of success is not the completion of an engagement. It is the capability the organisation retains, the confidence leadership gains and the strength the organisation continues to build long after the engagement has concluded.

Experience

Greatstone brings two decades of work inside organisations, across a broad range of industries and at every level from the executive team to the people doing the work each day. That experience is why we begin with understanding. We have seen enough organisations to know that the presenting problem is rarely the real one, and that the difference between an initiative that holds and one that quietly unwinds is almost always decided before any change begins. Today we bring that experience together with AI-enabled automation, and we run our own company on the same agent teams we set up for clients.

Legal

Privacy policy

Last updated 6 October 2026.

Who we are

Greatstone International Limited (“Greatstone”, “we”, “us”) runs greatstoneint.com and is the controller of the personal data described on this page. We are registered in England and Wales under company number 06248967, with our registered office at Parley Brook Farm, Littlewick Road, Woking, Surrey, GU21 4XR.

For anything about your data, email dx@greatstonesoftware.co.uk. We will reply to privacy questions at that address.

What this page covers

This website and the enquiry form on it. If you become a client, we tell you separately how we handle data in that work.

What we collect

When you send an enquiry. Your work email, which we need to reply, plus anything else you choose to give: your name, company, organisation size, sector and message. With it we save the date and time, the page you sent it from, and how you reached us on this visit (the site that referred you and any campaign tags in the link, such as utm_source). If you accepted analytics cookies, we also save how you first found us. We keep your IP address for 30 days to stop spam and abuse of the form.

When you browse. If you accept analytics cookies, Google Analytics records how the site is used: pages viewed, device and browser type, and an approximate location. Google Analytics does not store your IP address. We never send your name or email to Google Analytics. If you decline, no analytics cookies are set. Google may still receive basic signals with no cookies and no identifier, such as the fact that a page loaded, which it uses to estimate overall traffic.

We do not ask for sensitive information such as health or political views. Please leave it out of your message.

How we use it, and why we are allowed to

• Reply to your enquiry and discuss working together. Data used: enquiry details. Lawful basis: legitimate interests, answering a business that asked about our services. If you write to us for yourself, steps you asked us to take before a contract.
• Tell our team a new enquiry has arrived. Data used: enquiry details. Lawful basis: legitimate interests.
• See which campaigns and pages lead to enquiries. Data used: referrer, landing page, campaign tags. Lawful basis: legitimate interests.
• Protect the form from spam and abuse. Data used: IP address. Lawful basis: legitimate interests.
• Measure how the site is used. Data used: analytics data. Lawful basis: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

Sending an enquiry does not sign you up to marketing emails. We do not make automated decisions about you.

Who we share it with

We use a small number of providers to run the site. Each works under a contract that allows it to use your data only on our instructions.
• Supabase stores enquiries in our database, in London.
• Resend sends our team the email alert for each new enquiry.
• Pipedrive is where our team records an enquiry and follows it up.
• Netlify hosts the website and keeps short-lived server logs, which include IP addresses.
• Google runs Tag Manager and Analytics. It sets analytics cookies only if you accept them; if you decline, it receives only the basic signals described above.

We do not sell your data. We share it with others only if the law requires us to.

Data outside the UK

Some of these providers process data in the United States. Where they do, we rely on UK adequacy regulations (including the UK Extension to the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, where the provider is certified) or the ICO’s International Data Transfer Agreement or Addendum. Email us for details.

How long we keep it

• Enquiries: 24 months after our last contact with you, then deleted. Copies in our team’s email are deleted on the same schedule. If you become a client, we keep what the work needs under that contract.
• IP address saved with an enquiry: 30 days.
• Analytics data: 14 months.

Your rights

You can ask us to give you a copy of your data, correct it, delete it, restrict how we use it, or move it to another provider where that applies. You can object to any use based on legitimate interests, and you can withdraw consent for analytics at any time from Cookie settings in the footer. Email dx@greatstonesoftware.co.uk. It is free, and we reply within one month.

If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, please tell us first so we can put it right. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office at ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint or on 0303 123 1113.

Security

Enquiries are sent over an encrypted connection and stored in a database that only named Greatstone staff can read.

Children

This site is for businesses. It is not aimed at anyone under 18.

Changes

When this page changes, the date at the top changes too.

seo.title: Cookie policy · Greatstone International
seo.description: The cookies and browser storage greatstoneint.com uses, and how to change your choice.

pages.html:
Legal

Cookie policy

Last updated 6 October 2026.

The short version

We use a few small files and browser storage entries to make the site work, and, only if you say yes, analytics and preference cookies to see how the site is used and show you more of what you read. We do not use advertising cookies.

What cookies are

Cookies are small text files a website saves on your device. Sites can also save similar information in your browser’s local storage. This page covers both and calls them “cookies”.

Essential cookies (always on)

The site needs these to work, so they do not ask for consent.
• gs-studio: holds a copy of the site’s pages in your browser, so pages load and show correctly. It holds site content only, nothing about you. Kept until you clear your browser storage.
• gs-consent: remembers your cookie choice, so we do not ask again. Kept until you clear your browser storage.
• gs_service_inquiry_v1: remembers the services you added to an enquiry. Kept until you send the enquiry or clear your browser storage.
• gs-studio-session: keeps Greatstone staff signed in to the site editor. Not set for visitors. Kept until the browser tab is closed.
• sb-…-auth-token: keeps you signed in, only if you sign in to an account. Kept until you sign out.

Analytics and preference cookies (only if you accept)

These run only after you choose Accept analytics. They help us see which pages are useful and which campaigns bring people to the site, and remember what you looked at so the site can show you more of it. If you decline, or later change your mind in Cookie settings, we remove the ones we set.
• _ga (Google Analytics): tells one visitor from another, without identifying you. 2 years.
• _ga_… (Google Analytics): keeps track of a single visit. 2 years.
• gs-attr-first, gs-attr-last (Greatstone): remembers how you first and most recently reached the site (referring site, campaign tags, landing page), so an enquiry can tell us which campaign worked. Kept until you clear your browser storage.
• gs-intel-profile (Greatstone): on the AI Market Intelligence page, remembers which topics and vendors you read, so the “For you” feed shows related items. The profile stays in your browser. Kept until you clear your browser storage.
• gs_service_pop_v1 (Greatstone): on service pages, keeps a copy of which services are most viewed, so the “Popular” list loads quickly. Kept until you clear your browser storage.
• gs_service_pop_seen_v1 (Greatstone): on service pages, notes which services you viewed in this visit, so a page refresh is not counted twice. Kept until the browser tab is closed.

Google holds the analytics data for 14 months. Google’s own explanation is at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.

If you decline, Google may still receive basic signals with no cookies and no identifier, which it uses to estimate overall traffic.

Changing your choice

Use Cookie settings in the footer at any time to accept or decline analytics. You can also delete cookies and site storage in your browser settings, or install Google’s opt-out add-on at tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.

Questions

Email dx@greatstonesoftware.co.uk. More on how we use personal data is in our Privacy policy.
